title: Screenshots, a demo video, and data that is not "test test"

videos.script: A reviewer who opens your project and sees an item called test, lent to test test, learns two things. That you tested it by hand, and that you stopped there. {{test}} The data in a demo is part of the demo. Believable data makes the screenshot mean something, the video tell a story and the empty cases obvious, and it takes one small script to have it every time. {{data}} loanbook's script is twenty-four lines. It feeds the screenshot and the video. And one rule about data is not a matter of taste: it is never anybody's real data.
